task:
A fund holds 5492 credits. Its first grant is 17% of that original balance. Return 38% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 8% of the original balance minus 8 credits (the 8 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 16 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 10 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 15 credits.

Adjustment 17: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
